summary: Two TextFields with a button inside the border: a read-only share link with a copy IconButton and a coupon code with an Apply button.
use: A field with its own action: copy a value, apply a code, submit a search, with the button keeping its own name and Tab stop.
spec: `label="Share link" readonly` with `suffix={copyBtn}`: a text-variant small IconButton named "Copy link" ("Link copied" after a click)
`label="Coupon code"` with `suffix={applyBtn}`: a ghost small Button "Apply", disabled while the field is empty
The fields are stacked in a column, `max-width: 24rem`, `gap: var(--ca-space-4)`
